nativeFieldRecipe.scope: Maximum recorded prototype sampling/smoothing footprint, not a native appearance certificate.

recipe.fieldEncoding: Little-endian RGBA16F, linear source moments and density; divide moment by density AFTER interpolation. No colour averaging before interpolation.
recipe.textureOrder: x fastest, then y, then z; NumPy source[x,y,z,channel] transposed to[z,y,x,channel]
recipe.densityUnits: Leaf square metres per cubic metre
recipe.rootScale: For uniform scale s, world density=local density/s; world ray step=s*local step. Native root RGB tint multiplies reconstructed pigment once.

exposure.scope: Static own-canopy hemisphere escape: weighted exp(-0.5*integrated density), not directional or neighboring-tree shadow

recipe.biologicalClipping: Texture coordinates and density remain unchanged. Draw bounds and shader reject localY<0; source ground plane is not a green cap.
recipe.samplingFootprintScope: sqrt(3)*cellMetres is an authored voxel interpolation footprint, not a native foliage appearance certificate

qualification.scope: Immutable source-derived foliage textures only; no source geometry/material or far-mass edits, no growth. Root owns rendering and appearance acceptance.

limitations: RGBA16F quantizes source Float32 density/moments. Pairing preserves interpolated ratio semantics, not bit-exact pigment values.
Cached smoothing and finite source MASK quadrature retain their original uncertainty and source receipts.
Extinction and five-ray own-canopy exposure are authored approximations. Leaf underside, transmission and detailed self-shadowing are not fully reproduced.
Foliage only: original/reduced native wood must remain a separate draw. No fitted trunk or coarse crown geometry is emitted.
Native stand comparisons and GPU/device performance checks remain required before release.
